notes: A dress-up game, which Roleplay & Avatar Sim owns outright as its Dress Up subgenre, so the Dress Up preset carries the mode. Its stage-runway shape is contradicted by the answers on both counts — there are no judges or audience, only a mirror-walk, and the whole build is one enclosed boutique studio the player never leaves — so I substituted interior-single from the genre's typical list and kept the preset name; that also keeps it off P3, since there is no exterior to link. Dropped the preset's social-hub because the prompt says single-player, and used district-zoned for the requested separation of dressing, runway, and photo-booth zones inside the one room, with vignette-photo carrying the photo booth's composed backdrops. Everything else the prompt lists — coins, daily rewards, achievements, tag scoring, UI palette, future multiplayer — is systems and interface rather than layout, so it does not place geometry.
